title: Jehoiakim
summary: Jehoiakim is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Iuda, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only and is not converted to BC.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology (1830, 2nd ed.) prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (18. Jehoiakim 11 608). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 789b
reign.note: Year cell "4086 3404 411". The third printed figure 411 is the column "Temple", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 11 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Iuda..

reign.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxvi
